reasoning: The icon is a simple concentric circle and dot, universally used both as a monochrome 'record' button and as a selected UI radio button (and secondarily a target or center dot). It works for tasks centered on recording audio, video, or screencasts, though its strong resemblance to a list checkbox/radio button in a to-do app lowers its distinctiveness.
